verdict.rationale: Bases is a first-party core plugin for creating database-like views of notes (obsidian-docs-6). Community users describe it as a fast, mostly complete replacement for Dataview that turns queries into tables (obsidian-comm-5, obsidian-comm-6), and the Notion importer converts Notion databases into Bases (obsidian-docs-29). missing for 10: explicit documentation of filtering or querying by structured note properties, evidence of board and list view types beyond tables, in-depth first-party docs on live view behavior (community notes Bases is not yet as comprehensive as Dataview).
